rationale: Implementation is clean and follows all existing ADO toolkit conventions. RemoveWorkItemRelationTool is a minimal primitive — one patch op, wrapped in try/except matching the existing pattern. MoveWorkItemTool correctly handles three scenarios: existing parent (remove + add), no parent (add only), None relations (add only). The endswith(f'/{new_parent_id}') verification check avoids the substring false-positive (e.g. ID 100 matching .../workItems/1009). _HIERARCHY_REVERSE moved to module top as a proper constant. 12 new unit tests cover all branches including the false-positive guard and verification failure path. Toolkit count updated from 9 to 11 with explicit name assertions. make ruff passes clean. Harness sanity-api: 186 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed.

business_review.criterion: move_work_item succeeds for a work item that already has a parent (no TF201036)
business_review.notes: Tool fetches current relations, finds the Hierarchy-Reverse index, batches remove + add in one update_work_item call. TF201036 cannot occur because the old parent is removed before the new one is added.

business_review.criterion: move_work_item succeeds for a work item with no current parent
business_review.notes: Conditional remove step only appends the remove op when a Hierarchy-Reverse relation is found. No-parent case produces an add-only patch.

business_review.criterion: remove_work_item_relation correctly removes the relation at the given index
business_review.notes: Single JSON Patch remove op sent to update_work_item. Index 0 is explicitly tested.

business_review.criterion: Reparenting is atomic — single API round-trip
business_review.notes: Both remove and add ops batched into one update_work_item(document=[...]) call.

business_review.criterion: Post-move verification uses exact URL match
business_review.notes: rel.url.endswith(f'/{new_parent_id}') prevents false-positive on substring matches (e.g. ID 100 in URL .../1009).

business_review.criterion: All 11 tool names present in toolkit definition
business_review.notes: test_toolkit.py asserts len == 11 and checks all 11 names by string.

business_review.criterion: Error handling follows existing toolkit convention
business_review.notes: Both tools wrap execute body in try/except Exception, log with logger.error, raise ToolException. MoveWorkItemTool re-raises ToolException without wrapping to avoid double-wrapping the verification failure message.

business_review.criterion: No changes to existing tools or API contracts
business_review.notes: All changes are additive. No existing tool classes, routes, or response models were modified.

standards_review.notes: make ruff passes cleanly; no lint or format violations.
No new security surface. Token and URL are sourced from the existing AzureDevOpsWorkItemConfig, consistent with all other tools in the toolkit.
